meta.changelog: v0.4: added 2nd micro question per cluster (q23-q32), each tagged with its target 'cluster' for Phase 1 routing. v0.3: micro deltas reworked (parent <= 0.4, differentiator 0.7-1.0).
meta.normalization_note: trait_max must be computed PER SESSION over only the questions actually asked (macro 10 + the 2-4 micro questions of the routed clusters). Static macro-only maxes below; add each asked micro question's per-trait max at runtime.

questions.question_text: It's a free Saturday afternoon. Which activity sounds the most fun to you?

options.text: Fixing or taking apart a gadget, bike, or appliance to see how it works.
Playing strategy or puzzle games, or trying a simple coding tutorial.
Redecorating your room or sketching ideas for your dream house.
Volunteering for a barangay activity or tutoring younger kids.

questions.question_text: In group projects, which task do you usually volunteer for?

options.text: Building the model, demo, or the actual thing the group will present.
Writing the report or script, and making the presentation look good.
Computing the budget, costs, and other numbers for the project.
Explaining the final output in front of the class and answering questions.

questions.question_text: Which videos do you usually end up watching for hours?

options.text: Medical stories, how the human body works, or science experiments.
Animals, farms, forests, or life in the ocean.
Airplanes, ships, and how travel and transport work.
Courtroom dramas, news debates, or stories about how society works.

questions.question_text: Your class will put up a booth for the school fair. Which booth would you join?

options.text: A games booth with lights, wires, and moving parts that you built yourself.
An art and photo booth with backdrops and designs you created.
A food stall where you handle the money and track the sales.
A storytelling, trivia, or talent show booth.

questions.question_text: Your barangay wants to solve a local problem. Which project would you most want to join?

options.text: A free health check-up and first-aid day for residents.
A community garden or tree-planting project.
A reading and feeding program for street children.
Fixing street lights or improving roads and drainage.

questions.question_text: Which of these tasks sounds the most interesting to you?

options.text: Finding patterns in numbers, like sports stats or sales records.
Solving logic puzzles or figuring out why a program has an error.
Measuring and sketching a space so everything fits perfectly.
Carefully mixing chemicals or ingredients and measuring the results.

questions.question_text: Your school is organizing an outreach program. Which role would you pick?

options.text: Assisting the nurse or doctor, like checking blood pressure.
Teaching young kids how to read and write.
Interviewing residents and writing their stories for a report.
Organizing the schedule, budget, and supplies for the whole event.

questions.question_text: Imagine your future workplace. Which one excites you the most?

options.text: A cockpit, an airport control tower, or the deck of a large ship.
A laboratory with microscopes, samples, and test tubes.
Your own office or store that you built from nothing.
A classroom full of students learning from you.

questions.question_text: Which school competition would you most likely join?

options.text: A math or statistics quiz bee.
A robotics, programming, or science invention contest.
A poster-making, photography, or design contest.
A debate, public speaking, or mock trial competition.

questions.question_text: Which news headline would make you stop scrolling and read the whole story?

options.text: Scientists discover a new medicine for a serious illness.
A small Filipino startup grows into a billion-peso company.
The Philippines wins an award for a new bridge or building design.
A new law is passed to protect ordinary citizens.

questions.question_text: Your school is building a mobile app. Which part of the project would you choose?

options.text: Writing the code that makes the app smart, like a feature that gives recommendations.
Setting up the computers and network, and making sure the app runs smoothly.
Designing how the app looks, like the colors, buttons, and animations.
Studying user data to find patterns and predict what people will do next.

questions.question_text: You are volunteering at a hospital for a week. Which task would you prefer?

options.text: Testing blood and other samples in the laboratory to find what is wrong.
Assisting patients directly, like giving medicine and checking vital signs.
Guiding an injured patient through exercises so they can move again.
Helping a patient relearn daily tasks like eating, writing, or getting dressed.

questions.question_text: If you became a teacher, which situation would you enjoy the most?

options.text: Teaching young kids the basics, like reading and counting, through play and songs.
Teaching high school students a subject you really know well.
Creating special learning activities for children with special needs.
Coaching sports and teaching students about fitness and health.

questions.question_text: An engineering company hires you for a summer project. Which team would you join?

options.text: The team designing a bridge or tall building that can survive earthquakes.
The team building robots, drones, or machines with moving parts.
The team working on wires, circuits, and power systems.
The team finding ways to make a factory faster and less wasteful.

questions.question_text: You and your friends start a small online shop. Which job fits you best?

options.text: Recording every sale and expense, and double-checking the records.
Thinking of new products to sell and how to attract customers.
Studying prices and trends to decide the best price for your items.
Managing the deliveries, suppliers, and daily operations.

questions.question_text: Your work will be featured in a public exhibit. What would you rather create?

options.text: A painting, sculpture, or art installation.
A collection of clothes or fashion pieces.
A short film, animation, or digital video.
A live stage performance, like acting, dancing, or music.

questions.question_text: A research team is recruiting student assistants. Which study would you join?

options.text: Tracking stars, planets, and how objects move in space.
Studying rocks, soil, and how the Earth changes over time.
Testing chemical reactions to help create new materials or medicine.
Measuring weather patterns and helping predict storms.

questions.question_text: You are offered free training in the travel and transport industry. Which path would you take?

options.text: Learning to fly an airplane as a pilot.
Learning to repair and maintain airplane engines and parts.
Learning to navigate and operate a large ship across the ocean.
Learning to run the engines and machines inside a ship.

questions.question_text: You join a community organization. Which role would fit you best?

options.text: Helping investigate how a crime happened and gathering evidence.
Helping struggling families get food, support, and services.
Studying why groups of people think and behave the way they do.
Debating policies and learning how government and other countries work.

questions.question_text: Which of these projects would you enjoy the most?

options.text: Taking care of sick animals and learning how to treat them.
Growing crops or raising fish using modern techniques.
Turning farm products into a profitable business.
Developing new food products that are safe, tasty, and long-lasting.

questions.question_text: How important is getting a scholarship or studying in a state university for your college plans?

options.text: Very important. I need a full scholarship or a state university slot to be able to study.
Important. I can pay some of the costs, but I would need a partial scholarship or financial aid.
A little important. My family can pay, but any discount or aid would really help.
Not important. My family can afford private school tuition without aid.

questions.question_text: What are your plans for your career after college?

options.text: I plan to work or migrate abroad as soon as possible.
I want to work in the Philippines first, then try going abroad later.
I prefer to stay in the Philippines, but I am open if a good offer from abroad comes.
I plan to build my whole career here in the Philippines.

questions.question_text: For a school science fair, which project would you rather build?

options.text: A bridge or dam model tested against heavy weight.
A robotic arm that can pick up objects.
A solar-powered charging station for phones.
A sensor system that automatically controls lights and machines.

questions.question_text: Which hospital job would you rather do?

options.text: Preparing medicines and explaining to patients how to take them safely.
Operating X-ray and scanning machines to help doctors see inside the body.
Caring for mothers and babies during pregnancy and childbirth.
Helping a child speak again after an illness or injury.

questions.question_text: Which class would you enjoy teaching the most?

options.text: Reading, writing, and good values for elementary kids.
A math or science subject for high school students.
Practical skills like cooking, carpentry, or farming.
Helping students find books and reliable information in the library.

questions.question_text: Which business task sounds the most fun?

options.text: Pitching your own new product idea to investors.
Managing employees and making daily operations run smoothly.
Helping families buy their first house or condo.
Planning tours and promoting local destinations to visitors.

questions.question_text: Which finished work would make you the proudest?

options.text: A cozy cafe interior you designed.
A useful everyday product you designed, like a better chair or bottle.
A story, poem, or script you wrote.
A house or building you designed from scratch.

questions.question_text: Which discovery would excite you the most?

options.text: Proving a new math idea nobody has solved before.
Understanding how energy, motion, and electricity really work.
Mapping which parts of your city are most at risk of flooding.
Studying DNA and how diseases work at the smallest level.

questions.question_text: Which work setup would you prefer?

options.text: In a lab, designing and testing aircraft parts.
Months at sea, leading the ship's deck crew.
Months at sea, running the ship's engine room.
At an airport hangar, keeping airplanes safe to fly.

questions.question_text: Which topic could you talk about for hours?

options.text: Philippine history and culture.
Laws, rights, and defending people fairly.
Other countries, cultures, and global issues.
Why people think, feel, and behave the way they do.

questions.question_text: Which project would you join?

options.text: Protecting forests and wildlife.
Raising healthy farm animals.
Improving rice or crop harvests using science.
Running a fish farm and keeping the water clean.

questions.question_text: Which tech job would you choose?

options.text: Building computer hardware and circuit boards.
Using data to help a company make big decisions.
Predicting trends and results from surveys and statistics.
Defending a company from hackers and online attacks.
